description: Na₂Mn₂Si₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.58 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form MnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.13 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.70 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one Si atom to form corner-sharing ONa₂MnSi tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mn, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaMn₂Si tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Mn, and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Mn and one Si atom.
